title: REPLACE_ROOF payload
description: Replace the roof by template R-01 FLAT, R-02 SHED, R-03 GABLE, R-04 HIP on the current footprint and rebuild the walls (v0.3 §6 C-05; v0.2 C.1-C.4; spec §10.3). R-02..R-04 accept only a rectangular footprint (domain refusal UNSUPPORTED_FOOTPRINT).

slopeAxis.description: SHED: Z rises from zLow to zHigh along the positive axis [A].

symmetric.description: GABLE: ridge on the mid line (v0.2 C.3, D.3).

ridgeOffsetM.description: GABLE, symmetric = false: ridge position from the mid line along the other axis [A].

slopesDeg.description: HIP: slopes of the four faces, in the order of the footprint outer ring edges [A].

$comment: Given values per template from v0.2 C.1-C.4; `footprintId`, `ridgeAxis`, `eaveZ`, `ridgeZ`, `symmetric` as in v0.2 D.3; `roofZ`, `roofPlane`, `zLow`, `zHigh`, `slopeAxis` from C.1-C.2. [P] `template`, `measurementIds`, `slopeDeg`, `ridgeOffsetM`, `slopesDeg`. Members of another template are not rejected by the schema [A]. R-04 undetermined ridge length is a domain refusal (UNDERCONSTRAINED_GEOMETRY).
